distinctFrom: ARE engineering maturity checks (L0–L4). Passing these probes is NOT a full conformance certification.

rules.subject: transport
rules.claim: The endpoint accepts single JSON-RPC requests via HTTP POST and appropriate Accept header

rules.subject: version
rules.claim: Modern requests include protocolVersion and clientCapabilities in _meta; HTTP version agrees with body

rules.subject: discovery
rules.claim: server/discover advertises modern supportedVersions, capabilities, and identity

rules.subject: result
rules.claim: Results include resultType=complete or input_required as appropriate

rules.subject: cache
rules.claim: Cacheable lists include ttlMs and cacheScope

rules.subject: headers
rules.claim: Mcp-Method and applicable Mcp-Name match request body; reject disagreements with 400 and -32020

rules.subject: tool_order
rules.claim: Tool listing uses stable order to aid caching

rules.subject: auth
rules.claim: When authorization is enabled, HTTP auth follows MCP authorization requirements

rules.subject: subscriptions
rules.claim: Servers advertising change notification support implement subscriptions/listen semantics
